reviews.author: Anthony Moore
reviews.text: I was referred to Gold Standard Auto Body in early Oct. 2025. My Ford Edge had significant DMG to right front end/qtr panel, tie rod. Spoke w/Brad Arrowood got a wrecker to deliver car to him on 10/08/25. Brad answers phone promptly & professionally, calls you back when he commits! He quoted & sent an email estimate giving a 7 work day turnaround for repairs which was 100% accurate (a day early in fact). I had a 3rd pty paying & he also worked great directly w/them accepting their payment & solid communication. The finished work exceeded my expectations, looks like new & car was detail cleaned (exterior). Really pleased. I'd refer to anyone!

reviews.author: John Morris
reviews.text: Absolutely thrilled with the experience at Gold Standard Auto Body in Hickory! Jim and his team are true professionals who go above and beyond. It's rare to find a shop that not only understands the value of a 56-year-old vehicle, but treats it with the care, precision, and respect it deserves. Their craftsmanship is top-notch, and their passion for doing things the right way really shows. If you’re looking for people who genuinely care and take pride in their work, this is the place to go. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Handsome Devil
reviews.text: Got two quotes. Gold Standard was several thousand less because the other place wanted to replace the entire door over a cosmetic dent. The body work looks fantastic to boot. I could write more but this company is trustworthy and does great work.

reviews.author: angela adams
reviews.text: I was recommended by another local company that Gold Standard did good work. My 4 Runner had been hit when I was in a parking lot. It didn’t do a ton of damage but I wanted it fixed. Bruce was the gentleman that helped me. He was kind and gave me and estimate. He worked with my insurance company and we made plans for me to put the 4 Runner in the shop. I took it on a Monday morning and had it back by 2pm on Thursday. They knew I didn’t have a back up vehicle and they did their best to get it back to me as soon as they could . The vehicle looks fantastic and you can’t tell anything ever happened to it! All of the staff that I met while in their office was super kind and friendly! I highly recommend you choose Gold Standard Auto! Thanks again guys!

reviews.author: Brian Jones
reviews.text: We were referred by someone that worked at Paramount hyundai of hickory. I was in a fender bender a couple of weeks ago and i called gold standard and spoke with brad. From the get go he was professional and worked our vehicle in a timely manner. From start to finished they communicated often. Let me just say this you can't tell our vehicle was never damaged absolutely perfect. Don't waste your time looking for someone esle give the guys a call.

reviews.author: Gil “Dive99ft”
reviews.text: This place is awesome. One of their competitors had a 3 month wait and weren't very friendly. My insurance appraiser recommended 3 auto body shops. Gold Standard was the only one I called. Spoke with Bruce Thursday, had my truck in Monday and completed by Thursday morning. Very professional and excellent work. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dean Thompson
reviews.text: I’m writing to thank Brad and the team at Gold Standard for taking such terrific care of my vehicle. Brad is a true professional. He presented the options involved with the repair and didn’t attempt to “upsell” their services. The work was performed promptly and well. He kept me informed throughout the process and the Gold Standard team did a great job. I wholeheartedly recommend Brad and Gold Standard!

reviews.author: Tony Wylie
reviews.text: Ive had 2 vehicles painted there. A harley i laid down and a new truck i had the bumper painted. The paint job on both was perfect. If i ever nedd paint work done gold standard will do it for me..There do great work and very fair on the prices!

reviews.author: Cecilia Nolf
reviews.text: These guys did an amazing job on my car. The color (fire engine red) matches perfectly. They were very efficient and easy to work with!

reviews.author: Jon
reviews.text: My wife's Volvo needed a front grill replaced. We chose to take it to a body shop familiar with Volvo. Paramount Volvo of Hickory recommended Gold Standard Auto Body. After the initial phone call to inquire about the repair it was obvious why the shop was referred. Very professional and pleasant. An appointment was scheduled with the knowledge I would wait, patiently, until the repair was completed. Upon arriving I was greeted by Brad who was very accommodating and hospitable. The wait was not nearly as long as anticipated...actually only a matter of minutes it seemed. I would highly recommend any looking for auto body repair to contact Gold Standard Auto Body first. You won't be disappointed. Once again...thank you for the outstanding service.

reviews.author: Jessie Haynes
reviews.text: Excellent experience with Gold Standard! My car was in an accident and while I was not at fault, Gold Standard provided an exceptional experience. They were honest, professional, compassionate, and most of all, helpful. Brad at Gold Standard exceeded expectations and went far beyond what insurance companies would provide in terms of how the process worked, what to expect, what I needed to do, etc. I will absolutely use Gold Standard again if a need arises.

reviews.author: Ann Jolly
reviews.text: My dealing were with Bruce at Gold Standard. He was very professional. They took care of everything including dealing with my insurance company. Had to have the front bumper replaced on my K5 due to someone losing a cement block off of a trailer and I could not avoid hitting it. The job they did on my car was excellent. They perfectly matched my paint also. If i ever have to use a body shop again, this is the one I'll come back too. If I could give them 10 stars I would.

reviews.author: Denise Sigmon
reviews.text: Through the years with children having car accidents, etc., Jim Bright has always done the best work for me and my family. I am happy that he is now retired and left the BEST BODY SHOP EVER in such good hands! Gold Standard lives up to its name! Anyone who is considering another body shop for repairs is wasting time. GOLD STANDARD ROCKS!!!!

reviews.author: Aleesha Hunt
reviews.text: Very pleased with the service I received from Gold Standard. From the minute I walked thru the door for an estimate I knew I had chosen the right place to fix my car. Not only did they do exceptional work I can't tell I ever hit a deer but they also gave me 300.00 bucks back out of my insurance check when the work was completed. Most companies would have not been honest and done that they could have easily pocketed that money and I'd have never known. Thank you so much for not only be great but also being honest. I will definitely recommend Gold Standard to anyone needing work done.

reviews.author: Karen Bolick
reviews.text: Good Job. I have taken my vehicle to Gold Standard in Hickory twice now -Very happy both times. I drive a 2008 Subaru Forester. I love my car and take very good care of it. I prefer it over a newer one. Of course the headlights showed their age being foggy, We have all seen it on older vehicles. I tried several DIY treatments for headlight restoration with no good results. I decided to spend the money and give my car a nice 'facelift 'so to speak. While getting the headlights replaced ,I decided to have the weather stripping around the doors replaced as well. The stripping was compressed allowing air noise to be an aggravation. My car with brand new headlights looks AWESOME!! The dingy headlights were aging my car. It looks so much better. Bruce and Brad made the experience so easy. I am happy with money well spent to make my car look its best --not to mention how much brighter my lights shine now. This is only the second time I have ever written a review but it is so well deserved. May God bless the crew and all involved at Gold Standard to keep making customers happy. 5 Gold Stars and a Gold metal in my book.

reviews.author: Lanie Tucker
reviews.text: Gold standard has fixed two different cars for me. Recently being my current car that I hit a deer with. They have been so kind and worked so well with us as we were communicating with our insurance company as well. After picking up my car, it was beautifully done and no sign of ever being wrecked. When I got my car home I noticed that the trunk would not open ( no fault of theirs )- we took the car to them today and they were kind enough to help my husband reset the battery and it works great. This saved us a trip to the Mazda dealership Charlotte and we are so grateful! I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Vicki Hodges
reviews.text: I recently had my back bumper replaced, due to a collision. Gold Standard did an awesome job. The paint matched perfectly. The repair took six days. Great turn around time. Thank you so much for a the great job.

reviews.author: P Kurth
reviews.text: So far, very good. Had a bumper issue and my regular mechanic referred me to Gold Standard. Looked at my problem on the spot, called me with an estimate, ordered the parts and all this in less than 30 minutes.

reviews.author: Christian Rossner
reviews.text: They painted a few panels on my Triumph S3 and all the newly painted panels match up perfectly with the old ones!

reviews.author: Colby Baker
reviews.text: I wish I could add photos of their work on here, but take my word when I say that they do exceptional work. They kept me updated through the entire process, consulted me when they needed decisions made, and got me done in a timely manner. The quality of work is top tier and I wouldn’t hesitate to use them again in the future if I have to. Plus, Brad has very good customer service skills and was very helpful.

reviews.author: Deborah Duncan
reviews.text: They did a fantastic job on my vehicle. Service was great, friendly staff and my car was ready when promised. Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Sid H
reviews.text: If there were 6 stars they'd get every piece of all 6. They are that good. I am picky and I want my stuff done right and want it to appear as if it were OEM and never wrecked. They surpassed on BOTH occasions. With a show room like theirs, you knew they had to be good. If the owner takes care of his own toys like this, you know the work has to be top shelf. Customer service was without a doubt, simply AWESOME!. The million times I called with questions, never was I disappointed. Oh yeah, their skill level is off the charts. Thank you so much guys for giving me back my new car new again. Sid H.

reviews.author: Rachel Forth
reviews.text: I would rate 10 stars if possible! I was in a situation where I was 30 minutes from home in a hot parking lot for hours, not knowing what to do with my dads vehicle. I googled "auto body shops" and called a company and was told that they only did work for insurance companies and was booked months out anyways, so the lady referred me to Gold Standards. I called, and I spoke to a guy named Brad. From that moment on, my whole situation was stress-free. I had the vehicle towed to Gold Standarnd, where we were treated with phenomenal professionalism. If every company could be managed like Gold Standard, the world would be a better place!

reviews.author: Pete Elafros
reviews.text: I have had work done at Gold Standard Auto Body 3 times and I have sent several coworkers and friends there. We have all had quality work done, at a more than fair price, and complete on time. The people there explain what they are doing, make suggestions, and assure your satisfaction. Gold Standard has done body work, interior trim repairs, along with some electrical for me. They recommend OEM and quality parts, knowing that’s the foundation for a good job. Where they can, they save you money. But my satisfaction with the quality was top on the list.

reviews.author: Natalie
reviews.text: My husbands front bumper cover had gotten hit and was cracked. Gold Standard did an awesome job fixing it and the paint job was perfect! It didn't take long either...about a week. We were very impressed. Thank you guys!

reviews.author: kerry strange
reviews.text: Couldn’t have asked for better service! The work was completed in the timeframe provided by Bruce. They never attempted to “tag” on anything extra to get more from the insurance company. The customer service is top notch and the employees that I worked with are personable and friendly. The finished work looks perfect and I couldn’t be happier!

reviews.author: Timothy Gibson
reviews.text: I have been using Gold Standard Auto Body Inc. for over a decade and I have never been disappointed. Top teir business with great communication. You will be up to date and informed through the whole process. If you want to be treated like more than a customer with honest guidance, this is the place!

reviews.author: Kehliesa Ledford
reviews.text: This was the third time I have had to do business with these wonderful people! I can’t drive so don’t judge me! But honestly I wouldn’t do business with anyone else! They are great at what they do and they always try to help you out if its possible! Brad and Jim are both amazing and I will always bring my car to them! Thank you guys so much for all the miracles you both do! You both are blessings to people like me!

reviews.author: Nick H
reviews.text: Highly recommend these guys.! They do great work! Car came out better than new, and I love that they repaired our bumper rather than just replacing it.! My wife's plastic (polyurethane) bumper had a bad gash and paint scrape.. the price was great and the repair was excellent.!

reviews.author: Whitney Coble Cline
reviews.text: It was an absolute pleasure working with Brad and Jim at Gold Standard. From the estimate all the way to pickup, they made everything easy and painless. The work they did on my 2014 Ford Escape is impeccable and it looks brand new! Highly reccomend as the best body shop in Hickory!

reviews.author: Myles Slaughter
reviews.text: Great, fast service and super communication. Honest as well: brought our price in under the estimate. We’ll go here again when we need auto body work done.

reviews.author: Richard Allen
reviews.text: All I wanted was my door handle replaced. I bought the part made an appointment an had the work done. It is terrible. A lot of folks let this kind of thing slide but not me. The seal around the housing is not flush and it causes the housing to sit unevenly. Jim asked me to pay cash and took 30 bucks less than the estimate. I would rather pay more and it be right! I don't know why people can't just be straight! Very disappointed.

reviews.author: Cherish Kaylor
reviews.text: Went in for an estimate. Wanted to get on their schedule and was denied service until insurance claim came through (I get it). I specifically stated that I was out of town and needed to make an appointment and I was denied. So we went with another company that was happy to put us on their schedule.

reviews.author: Rex Humphrey
reviews.text: Only place I take any of my and family's vehicle to from major repairs to customizing paint. They have never been disappointed for over 10yrs.

reviews.author: Jessie Deal
reviews.text: I wouldnt recommend them or use them again. I used them to fix my van after a tree fell on it. Made an insurance claim and they took it from there working out an estimate with insurance. We sent photos on top of took it to them and they took their own photos. They failed to tell me they would need my van for 2 weeks to fix it until the day i dropped it off so i had to last minute rearrange plans because it is a daily driver. Then when we picked it up things were not fixed properly and they tried to say they werent informed of that damage. They were and it should have been wrapped up in the insurance estimate. Plus the recite they gave me said that they buffed the spots they apparently werent informed of. Which i pointed out very clearly to them when they said they didnt know about it. They Completely avoided fixing the hood and tried to say the dents were from hail damage or nuts falling off trees however the dents arrived there after the tree fell on the van and we have not had any hail or parked anywhere nuts could fall on it. They took the van back and retouched some spots on the side but still said the hood would be up to 1000 to fix and im not paying it out of pocket for damage claimed through insurance. Also i got my van back with a deep scratch in my driver door that wasnt there before i dropped it off. They buffed over it the second time but didnt properly fix it. They dont seem to care about the work they do. Im glad i didnt waste money out of pocket on them. THE ONLY GOOD THING I GOT OUT OF IT WAS THEY VACCUMED MY ENTIRE PASSAGER VAN FOR ME. Other then that not impressed.

reviews.author: Tyler Bynum
reviews.text: I took my car to have a couple things fixed after someone hit my car. Kenny and Brad were amazing! I couldn’t have asked for better customer service, communication, or price! My car was fixed and ready in no time! Anytime I need auto body work done this is where I will be going! Thank you guys again for everything!

reviews.author: Kehliesa
reviews.text: They did an amazing job on my car!!! I am more than pleased with the work they have done!! Brad was great to work with an amazing with customer service!! If anyone needs body work done I would highly recommend these guys!! Thank you so much!!

reviews.author: Sol Jang
reviews.text: Tahoe grill replacement , front door fixed & back dent fixed. None of it was done properly so they had to come pick up and brought it back then truck is not properly installed it does not close & open properly and inside plastic parts are not assembled so it’s hanging off.. what a disappointment after 12-15k insurance check plus out of pocket.. I don’t recommend them for repairing Tahoe. Not up to my Standards at all.

reviews.author: Jim Cushing
reviews.text: Great work. Funny thing is i was quoted a low price by this business and when my adjuster looked at my car he awarded me about 50 dollars more than what i was quoted.Funny thing though, when i picked up me vehicle, they charged me what they quoted me plus the extra 50 dollars, lol! They charged me EXACTLY what my adjuster had wrote the check for, exactly even though they had quoted me lower, it's a racket. Great job though.

reviews.author: Beth Fulghum
reviews.text: Jim has done a lot of repairs for us. He is very honest & does a fantastic job. He cares about his customers & not greedy. Will do all he can to get his best price along with the work being done the way it should. You areally at the right place no need to look any further!!! Beth Fulghum

reviews.author: Jayson Lankford
reviews.text: The owner (Jim Bright) has been a friend of mine for a few years and done excellent body work on several of my vehicles. I live 2 counties away, but this is the only body shop that I will take my vehicles when they need work.

reviews.author: Joe Williamson
reviews.text: Haven't had the car repaired yet . They were friendly and I received the estimate quickly. I am hoping the repair is as good as I have been told by others who have had their vehicles repaired there.

reviews.author: Tony Curtis
reviews.text: I hit a deer with my wife's 2018 Ford Edge.I found Gold Standard on the net.I am very pleased with the quality of their work.I recommend them on every level.And even better,my wife is happy.Thanks Gold Standard.

reviews.author: Rockcrawler 66
reviews.text: Great paint shop. Brad was very knowledgeable about my needs and explained all the possibilities and expiration of what to expect during the process from start to finish.

reviews.author: Isaiah Mull
reviews.text: Body work is not that great headlight not lined up properly, painted my hood and get it back with a million swirls in the paint. What a joke $4100 in work and it comes back looking like that SMH.

reviews.author: Kc Partin
reviews.text: The quality of work and customer service is second to none. I have had several vehicles repaired here both looked better than new. I would highly recommend this shop.

reviews.author: Angelica LeMaster (Angel)
reviews.text: Bruce was very helpful, efficient, and professional. I was helped right away and the results were great. I definitely recommend. Thank you!

reviews.author: Len Lecompte
reviews.text: True professionals. Extremely happy with their work - communication was excellent from beginning to end and completed on schedule. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: mckenzie jackson
reviews.text: Highly recommend Gold Standard! Fixed my car and was very communicative through the whole process. I will definitely use them again!

reviews.author: Valentin Queval
reviews.text: I compared 3 bodyshop and went to this one cause it was the cheapest, work done great plus scrubbing some extra small scratches plus cleaning the inside. These guys are real passionate, great service, I totally recommend.

reviews.author: Amanda Singleton
reviews.text: Great service from beginning to end. Brad was very helpful and accommodating, worked with the insurance company and I had to do very little.

reviews.author: Jennifer Roan
reviews.text: Perfect repair, excellent customer service, all around great company to work with. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Banny Vongphachanh
reviews.text: I don’t recommend this place after my experience. Went to get my car for an estimate here and he wouldn’t even bother getting an estimate and told me to get an estimate somewhere else.

reviews.author: Roger Beaver
reviews.text: Mr. Bright is more than a "body man" he is a perfectionist. He is one of only a few I would have a car restored by.

reviews.author: Jessica Lowe
reviews.text: Wonderful customer service. Job was highest quality . Would reccomend anyone for auto repair to go here!

reviews.author: Robert RD1
reviews.text: Super friendly staff, easy to work with and they listen to you and take your needs in to account. Body work looks great too!

reviews.author: Al Corelli
reviews.text: Jim was able to fix what everyone else could not. The whole team at Gold Standard are true professionals.

reviews.author: wayne mercer
reviews.text: Do a lot of business with these folks, great guys and lots of knowledge about Autobody repair. They do excellent work!

reviews.author: Jermi Little
reviews.text: VERY RUDE and short with me when I went by there. I will not return or recommend anyone go there. The guy acts like I’m bothering him with simple questions about services he supposedly provides.

reviews.author: Veronica Jantz
reviews.text: Can't say enough about the service they give. We were very very pleased with color & finish. A & V Jantz

reviews.author: Cecelia Mull
reviews.text: The service was outstanding with a very friendly and helpful staff. Very honest with their work and service. I would highly recommend the service.

reviews.author: Ricky Brackett
reviews.text: I purchased a Kia Sportage and found 2 flaws in the paint which was a warranty issue and these guys handle Kia's paint issues. I was very worried about having a car with less than 200 miles on it sprayed and factory paint removed. When I picked up my car the paint was immaculate. No lines, no buff marks, no overspray! The paint looked factory! I was upset that I had a new car that needed paint and these guys eased my mind with a total professional job! Look at the photos and you will see!

reviews.author: Annette Guinyard
reviews.text: Shop owner very unprofessional and difficult to work with. Gave my insurance company a hard time with updates on my vehicle. Would NOT recommend.
